inputs: PR #3 (Derivanta Engine M1 `2922bdb`, M2 `0be2a38`) and PR #4 (M3 `562d2ec`), merged into this branch.

gaps.root_cause: --python is passed through unresolved; dependencies._python_installed runs it with cwd set to a probe directory
gaps.expected: a relative --python is resolved against the invocation directory before any subprocess changes directory; a missing interpreter is refused with a message and exit 2
gaps.observed: FileNotFoundError traceback, exit 1 (relative path and missing path)

gaps.root_cause: classify_command keeps the runner_args of the first recognized segment only
gaps.expected: every runner invocation in a multi-line run step counts as a CI scope; a suite no line runs is still a gap; line order does not change the result
gaps.observed: only the first unittest line of a step is a scope: false high CI_TEST_EXECUTION_GAP; swapping the lines moves the false gap
gaps.negative_controls: c1-multiline-only-a keeps the gap for b/tests

gaps.root_cause: _self_referential and _determinism read the same two-call pattern differently
gaps.expected: `a = f(x); assert a == f(x)` is the same weak determinism oracle as `assert f(x) == f(x)`, not a false green
gaps.observed: assigned form: FALSE_GREEN SELF_REFERENTIAL_ORACLE; direct form: WEAK_ORACLE DETERMINISM

gaps.failure_reproducer: Engine core/manifests.py (117 mutants, 35 survivors); synthetic >20 survivor run in tests
gaps.root_cause: item_count derives the denominator from the length of a truncated list
gaps.expected: the finding states the complete survivor count, how many are listed and that the list is cut; an assessment cannot declare the whole finding reviewed with fewer items than the run has
gaps.observed: MUTATION_SURVIVORS evidence lists 20 labels and no count; assessment.item_count falls back to that list, so 20/20 passes as complete for 35 survivors (M2: 70 survivors, 50 names, 20 sites)
gaps.test_before: tests/test_review_denominator.py: 7 failed on 0.10.0 (worktree 2e34542), incl. DID NOT RAISE for the M1 '20/20 of 35' assessment
gaps.negative_controls: a complete review (35/35) and a small untruncated run (2/2) are still accepted; PARTIAL with 20/35 is recorded as partial
gaps.metrics: finding evidence: count (all undetected), listed, truncated, sites, mutant_ids; report survivor_sites complete with mutant_id and status (0.10.0: 20 sites)
gaps.limitations: the finding lists 20 labels and the HTML shows 50 sites (the JSON keeps all); a review scope is still a number the agent states, checked against the count, not a list of mutant ids

gaps.failure_reproducer: docs/assurance/evidence/derivanta-0.10.1/fail-before-0.10.0.json AXF-05 (three -s suites over three steps, one failing test)
gaps.root_cause: _declared_args only uses a declaration when there is exactly one; declared_runners keeps whole step texts
gaps.expected: each declared unittest start directory is reproduced separately in the copy and the run says which ran; zero tests is never a pass
gaps.observed: several declared invocations -> falls back to `discover` at the root: 0 invocations, exit 5, UNKNOWN

gaps.root_cause: any handler whose body is pass counts as swallowing, whatever it catches
gaps.expected: `except (ErrA, ErrB): pass` around the subject is a limited typed-error oracle (another exception fails the test); `except Exception: pass` stays a swallowed exception
gaps.observed: typed handler reported as FALSE_GREEN SWALLOWED_EXCEPTION, the same as `except Exception` (the Engine saw NO_ASSERTION on a Hypothesis variant)

gaps.root_cause: the redundancy key ignores which module the body's names come from
gaps.expected: identical bodies that import different modules are not nominated as redundant; when the subject cannot be resolved the candidate says so
gaps.observed: REDUNDANCY candidate for a/tests and b/tests although each imports its own lib.py
gaps.limitations: not in the Engine's exported Portfolio (6 unique records); registered here and in the local Portfolio flow

gaps.expected: the Skill tells the agent to inspect closure statically first and to run foreign code only with authorization; a venv or copy is not an OS sandbox
gaps.observed: an agent proposed importing project code in a venv without authorization or a sandbox caveat
gaps.test_before: no case could observe execution: the M1 case is analysis-only (no fixture)
gaps.negative_controls: a read-only response leaves the verdict to the judge
gaps.metrics: SKILL.md Boundaries: 'Read before you run'; docs/EXECUTION_SECURITY.md agent guidance; new case UNTRUSTED_IMPORT_SIDE_EFFECT with execution marker
gaps.limitations: semantic evaluation NOT_RUN: running agent and judge needs the owner's budget approval; the M1 REVIEW stays REVIEW. The marker sees execution in the workspace only (a run in the agent's own copy is visible only in the guard log and response)

gaps.root_cause: only a constant test, a tuple and a self-comparison are tautologies
gaps.expected: `assert x == y or True` (any always-true operand of `or`) is a TAUTOLOGY candidate

gaps.root_cause: an unclassified step is read as absence
gaps.expected: a CI step running a repository script that runs pytest is not 'no pytest in CI'; a script that does not keeps the finding
gaps.observed: CI_PYTEST_NOT_OBSERVED (medium) for `python tools/gate.py` that runs pytest

gaps.root_cause: the summary is fixed text; the observed attributes are not recorded
gaps.expected: the evidence names what each test asserts about the error and what other tests pin, instead of 'only check the type'
gaps.observed: summary says the tests only check the type although one asserts exit_code

gaps.expected: every finding whose evidence list is cut also states the complete count, so an assessment scope is checked against the real total
gaps.observed: NATIVE_COLLECTION_ERRORS, BROKEN_PROJECT_LINK, NESTED_REPOSITORY, ARTIFACT_OMITS_SOURCE_FILES, STATE_AFTER_REJECTION_NOT_EVIDENCED, ERROR_CONTRACT_FIELD_NOT_OBSERVED, dependency findings: list cut at 20/30 with no count
gaps.test_after: passes: an AST guard over every Finding(...) with a literal evidence dict; it found one more case while being written (ARTIFACT_LINEAGE_UNKNOWN, cut at 10)
gaps.negative_controls: evidence spread from a helper that carries its own count is accepted
gaps.limitations: the guard reads literal evidence dicts only; evidence built in a variable is checked by review

gaps.expected: a step that runs two different runners (`pytest a && python -m unittest discover -s b`) declares both
gaps.observed: only the first recognized tool becomes the check's tool; the second runner's scope is lost
gaps.limitations: inferred from the code; reproduced in CP2 before it is fixed

gaps.expected: `cd sub && python -m pytest tests` scopes sub/tests
gaps.observed: a `cd` inside a step is ignored: scopes are read from the root
gaps.limitations: inferred from the code; reproduced in CP2 before it is fixed

gaps.expected: a rejection at construction (`with raises(E): Model(...)`) leaves no state to check afterwards
gaps.limitations: reported by the Engine on 2 of 20 tests read; reproduced in CP3 before any change

gaps.origin: Derivanta M2 maintainability scan of Assertiva
gaps.observed: _STRENGTH is defined and never read (one occurrence in the repository)

gaps.expected: a copy that cannot be complete because of Windows path length is reported, not silently partial
gaps.observed: Engine saw `git clone -q` under a long path check out 100 of 1512 files with no error
gaps.limitations: an Engine observation about git clone; Assertiva copies with Python, which may already fail loudly
gaps.next: build a fixture whose copy path exceeds 260 characters on Windows and compare the copied tree with the source fingerprint; fix only if Assertiva's copy loses files silently

gaps.expected: mutants no test covered are listed like survivors, not only counted
gaps.observed: MUTATION_SURVIVORS and survivor_sites iterate run.survivors(), which is SURVIVED only: NO_COVERAGE mutants were counted and never listed

ideas.idea: Optional advisory lookup for --dependencies (OSV / pip-audit / npm audit), network and opt-in
ideas.why: no consumer inside an audit yet; inventory already says vulnerabilities are UNKNOWN and names OSV-Scanner to reuse

ideas.idea: Budget-aware mutation sharding (AXO-M2-03): run a large module in traceable shards under the budget
ideas.why: must keep the full planned population as denominator; needs a design that cannot game the score

ideas.idea: Portable feedback intake manifest (import AXF/AFB lineage from dogfood PRs)
ideas.why: the JSON intakes plus `portfolio feedback add` cover the current single consumer

ideas.idea: Ingest Engine SARIF as untrusted candidate evidence (AXO-M2-08)
ideas.why: would add a second source of truth without a consumer in an audit

ideas.idea: Shared test helper for four similar tests/*::_run helpers
ideas.why: they drive different tools and keep fixture independence; merging saves little and couples them
